title: Effect of Ankle-foot Orthoses on Balance Confidence
brief_summary: The patients at our Prosthetics and Orthotics Outpatient Clinic who have had an ankle-foot orthosis for at least one year will fill in the Activities-Specific Balance Confidence Scale (ABC Scale) for wearing the orthosis and for not wearing the orthosis. They will also answer a mini survey about falls in order to determine whether they have fallen within the last 6 months.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients at our Prosthetics and Orthotics Outpatient Clinic having an ankle-foot orthosis for at least 1 year

Exclusion Criteria:

* insufficient cognitive ability to fill in the ABC Scale
study_population: All the patients of our Prosthetics and Orthotics Outpatient Clinic who have had an ankle-foot orthosis for at least 1 year and able to fill in the ABC Scale
